description: Oberhofen Castle stands in the water of Lake Thun, in the municipality of Oberhofen am Thunersee, with a medieval keep and a water tower capped by a spire. The romantic lakeside form is the nineteenth-century rebuilding around the old keep. It is not Thun Castle, not Spiez Castle, and not Schloss Hünegg. The Open-Meteo model is overcast and mild, about 17°C, with a breeze and no precipitation, and the sun is below the horizon.
